raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the familial relationships after the WebSurfer returned accurate information. They incorrectly inferred that Maria Josepha of Saxony (the Dauphin’s wife and Marie Zéphyrine’s mother) was the Dauphin’s mother, thus naming the mother instead of the paternal grandmother. This ignored the visible evidence that Louis XV’s wife (and thus Marie Zéphyrine’s paternal grandmother) was Marie Leszczyńska.
